visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People: Face/Hands] A trainer in a blue uniform and black boots gestures with his hands toward a dark, shiny sea lion. [Objects: Details/State] The sea lion waddles on a light-tan, wet concrete floor. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The scene is set in an outdoor enclosure with high rock walls and a wooden fence under bright, direct natural daylight. (2) [People: Face/Hands] A young boy in a white Mickey Mouse t-shirt and a girl in a white blouse walk across a dark floor. [Objects: Details/State] Their feet move through colorful, light-projected images of fish and water ripples. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The indoor space is large and dimly lit, allowing the vibrant digital floor projections to glow brightly and create a dreamlike atmosphere. (3) [People: Face/Hands] A boy in a tie-dye shirt reaches out his hand to touch a vertical screen. [Objects: Details/State] The screen displays colorful animated fish, seahorses, and bubbles that react to his touch. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The surrounding area is dark, with blue and purple ambient light reflecting off the interactive walls and the child's concentrated facial expression. (4) [People: Face/Hands] Two people in the foreground raise their arms in excitement as they look at a massive glass wall. [Objects: Details/State] Inside the tank, thousands of small silver fish swim in a dense school while a large, flat ray glides past. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The water is a brilliant, clear blue, illuminated by bright overhead lights that cast shimmering reflections throughout the enclosure. (5) [People: Face/Hands] Children point their fingers at touch-screen terminals with numerical "plus" icons appearing on the display. [Objects: Details/State] The screens show stylized undersea environments with cartoonish fish. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The indoor educational zone is well-lit with soft white lighting, highlighting the modern, interactive kiosks and the engagement of the visitors. (6) [People: Face/Hands] An audience of visitors sits on stone steps, holding smartphones up to record the performance. [Objects: Details/State] A sea lion waddles along a wet ledge in front of a blue water tank. [Setting: Background/Lighting] This outdoor stadium is bathed in bright sunlight, featuring realistic stone-textured backdrops and a high wooden fence that separates the performance area from the spectators. (7) [People: Face/Hands] A large bird with brown and white feathers flies extremely low over the heads of the seated audience, who duck slightly. [Objects: Details/State] A penguin is then seen through glass, swimming rapidly with its flippers through clear, bubbles-filled blue water. [Setting: Background/Lighting] The transition moves from the sunlit outdoor arena to the brightly lit, clear water of an indoor penguin exhibit.

(6) [Subtitle]: 整個沉浸式超夢幻. (7) [Subtitle]: 真的像走進海底世界一樣. (8) [Subtitle]: 還有整片水族牆也超壯觀. (9) [Subtitle]: 近距離看到. (10) [Subtitle]: 魟魚、鯊魚、水母. (11) [Subtitle]: 療癒到不行. (12) [Subtitle]: 還有互動遊戲區. (13) [Subtitle]: 觸控體驗. (14) [Subtitle]: 小孩也在這區玩了好久. (15) [Subtitle]: 還多了AR任務. (16) [Subtitle]: 最後還看了兩場精彩的. (17) [Subtitle]: 動物互動秀. (18) [Subtitle]: 有海獅表演. (19) [Subtitle]: 老鷹低空飛過頭頂. (20) [Subtitle]: 孩子們看的超投入. (21) [Subtitle]: Xpark越來越好玩. (22) [Subtitle]: 暑假可以來一趟旅行.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Xpark aquarium as a top family-friendly destination for summer holidays. It highlights newly introduced interactive exhibits that merge light technology with marine life, alongside traditional animal performances like sea lion shows and low-flying bird demonstrations, emphasizing a fun and 'healing' experience for children and adults alike.
